callToAction.title: Ready to Create Magical Bedtime Stories?
callToAction.body: Join TalePod today and start crafting personalized stories that your children will cherish forever.

items.question: How do I create a bedtime story on your platform?
items.answer: To create a bedtime story, simply navigate to the Create Story page and fill in the fields to create your own personalized story.

items.question: Can I read and listen to stories created by other users?
items.answer: Absolutely! You can explore and enjoy a wide range of stories created by our team and other users. Browse through the Library page to find both text and audio versions of various bedtime stories.

items.question: How do I contact customer support if I have a question or issue?
items.answer: If you have any questions or encounter any issues, you can contact our customer support team by visiting the Contact page from our menu.

items.question: Are there any guidelines for creating stories?
items.answer: We make sure that all stories created are appropriate for children and suitable for young audiences.

items.question: Can I share the stories I create on social media?
items.answer: Yes, you can share your stories on social media directly from our platform. Use the share button on your story page to post it on various social media platforms.

items.question: Is there a way to filter stories based on age or genre?
items.answer: Certainly! Our platform allows you to filter stories by age group and genre, ensuring you find the perfect story for your child's bedtime.

items.question: How does TalePod handle my child's data?
items.answer: TalePod collects only the information needed to personalize stories, such as a child's first name, age, and interests entered by a parent or guardian. We do not sell personal data. See our Privacy Policy for full details on collection, storage, and retention.

items.question: How does TalePod keep stories age-appropriate?
items.answer: Stories are generated with kid-safe defaults and content filters designed to keep language and themes suitable for young audiences. Parents choose the child's age when creating a story to help tailor tone and complexity.

items.question: Is TalePod compliant with children's privacy laws like COPPA?
items.answer: TalePod is designed for use by parents and guardians who create stories on behalf of children. We aim to follow applicable children's privacy requirements, including limiting data collection to what is necessary. Full compliance details are in our Privacy Policy — please review before use.

items.question: Does TalePod show ads to children?
items.answer: TalePod does not display third-party advertising within the story creation or reading experience. Our focus is on a calm, ad-free bedtime routine for families.
